requirements.text: 3–6 years of relevant experience in machine learning, generative AI, computer vision or a closely related field.
Hands-on experience training or fine-tuning modern image or video generation models, including diffusion, flow matching or comparable architectures.
A proven track record of shipping machine learning models into production products, rather than working exclusively on theoretical research or evaluation.
Experience with training pipelines and a strong understanding of training-data strategy.
Familiarity with generative-model evaluation, benchmarks and feedback loops.

Experience at a recognised generative-media, computer-vision or frontier AI company or research lab, such as Meta, ByteDance, Google DeepMind, Runway, Pika, Luma, Stability AI or a comparable organisation.
The ability to take ownership of a model's development, from initial training through to measurable product impact.

This is an in-office position in San Francisco, California, five days per week. Candidates already based in the Bay Area and those willing to relocate are welcome to apply. Visa sponsorship is available.
You can point to a specific image or video model, feature or capability that you personally trained and helped ship.
You understand how training-data choices influence model behaviour and can explain what you changed and why.
You've built evaluation harnesses, benchmarks or feedback loops that demonstrably improved generative-model performance.
You have experience with video generation, text-to-video, image generation or other modern generative-media systems.
Research publications or open-source contributions that complement a strong production track record.
